concepts.definition: a semiconductor device that converts light energy directly into direct-current electrical energy
an assembly of interconnected photovoltaic cells packaged to produce usable electrical power
a group of photovoltaic modules electrically connected to provide the required system voltage and current
a device that converts direct-current electricity into alternating-current electricity
a device that regulates electrical charge flowing between a solar array and a battery bank
an electrochemical device that stores electrical energy in chemical form for later use
the solar power received per unit area on a surface
the angle between a photovoltaic module surface and the horizontal plane
a circuit arrangement that adds component voltages while the same current flows through each component
a circuit arrangement that adds branch currents while maintaining the same voltage across each branch
